newsitem.title: SAUDI ARABIA: Saudi beheads murderer, Nigerian drugs smuggler.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads murderer, Nigerian drugs smuggler.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Monday beheaded a Saudi man for murder and a Nigerian man for drugs smuggling, raising to 76 the number of people executed in the conservative kingdom this year.
An Interior Ministry statement said the Saudi had shot dead another Saudi man. He was beheaded in the capital Riyadh.

Another ministry statement said the Nigerian was beheaded in the western port city of Jeddah for smuggling an unspecified quantity of heroin into the kingdom. He was the 13th person executed on drugs charges in the past month.
Saudi Arabia applies Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug traffickers and other criminals. A total of 68 people were beheaded in 1996.
